candidate_merges.message: Retry transient GraphQL failures in milestone changelog fetch-data (#21845) ## Failure The Milestone Changelog Generator's `fetch-data` job fails whenever GitHub's GraphQL gateway returns a transient **502/504** (or a truncated body) to one of its two `gh pr list --limit 5000` calls. Nothing retries, so one hiccup fails the whole scheduled run: **12 of 127 runs (~9%)** since 2026-10-06 (#21838).
